adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts` `updateEvent` now computes `selectedCalendar` as `externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;`. When `externalCalendarId` is falsy (the else branch), the `find` compares `cal.externalId === externalCalendarId` where `externalCalendarId` is `undefined/null`, so it will almost always return `undefined` and thus `selectedCalendar` becomes `undefined`. Previously the fallback was `event.destinationCalendar?.externalId` (single object), which would have produced a usable calendar id. The same broken fallback pattern is also introduced in `deleteEvent` (`calendarId` computation). This is a correctness regression for cases where callers don’t provide `externalCalendarId`.
